{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgPHKj3dSAYfRysTWLjDu","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_0165Yn7qJGndhJKgVkHLLpGc","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261025.160726/build/LayersTesting/tests/test_commands.py","content":"\"\"\"Behavior of the ledger commands, each run against a throwaway store in ``tmp_path``.\n\nEvery test acts through ``cli_runner`` and reads the outcome back through a command or the stored\nrow, never through captured diagnostic text. Seed files are read only to load them, and no test\ntouches the application store.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom cli.context import open_store\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nSOURCES = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / \"sources\"\nACCOUNT_HEADER = [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]\nTXN_HEADER = [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef store(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    monkeypatch.delenv(\"DATABASE_URL\", raising=False)\n    monkeypatch.setenv(\"DATABASE_PATH\", str(tmp_path / \"ledger.db\"))\n    assert cli_runner(\"init\")[0] == 0\n    return tmp_path\n\n\ndef parse(out: str) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out, newline=\"\")))\n\n\ndef write_csv(path: Path, header: list[str], rows: list[list]) -> str:\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as handle:\n        writer = csv.writer(handle, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        writer.writerow(header)\n        writer.writerows(rows)\n    return str(path)\n\n\ndef table_counts() -> list[int]:\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"count\")\n    assert code == 0\n    return [int(row[1]) for row in parse(out)[1:]]\n\n\ndef make_account(code: str, name: str | None = None) -> None:\n    assert cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code, name or f\"Name {code}\")[0] == 0\n\n\ndef make_categories(tmp_path: Path, *codes: str) -> None:\n    path = write_csv(tmp_path / \"cats.csv\", [\"category\", \"description\"],\n                     [[code, f\"Desc {code}\"] for code in codes])\n    assert cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", path)[0] == 0\n\n\ndef post(account: str, category: str, amount: str, day: str = \"2026-04-01\", memo: str = \"\"):\n    args = [\"txn\", \"post\", account, category, amount, day]\n    if memo:\n        args.append(memo)\n    return cli_runner(*args)\n\n\ndef balance_of(account: str) -> str:\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", account)\n    assert code == 0\n    return parse(out)[1][3]\n\n\ndef stored_count() -> int:\n    return table_counts()[2]\n\n\n# init and count\n\ndef test_init_on_a_brand_new_store_creates_the_tables(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    monkeypatch.delenv(\"DATABASE_URL\", raising=False)\n    monkeypatch.setenv(\"DATABASE_PATH\", str(tmp_path / \"fresh\" / \"ledger.db\"))\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"init\")\n    assert (code, out) == (0, \"\")\n    assert table_counts() == [0, 0, 0]\n\n\ndef test_init_prints_nothing_and_is_repeatable(store):\n    assert cli_runner(\"init\") == (0, \"\", \"\")\n    assert cli_runner(\"init\") == (0, \"\", \"\")\n\n\ndef test_init_empties_all_three_tables(store):\n    make_account(\"INITA\")\n    make_categories(store, \"INITC\")\n    assert post(\"INITA\", \"INITC\", \"5.00\").__getitem__(0) == 0\n    assert table_counts() == [1, 1, 1]\n    assert cli_runner(\"init\")[0] == 0\n    assert table_counts() == [0, 0, 0]\n\n\ndef test_init_with_an_extra_argument_is_usage_error_and_removes_nothing(store):\n    make_account(\"INITK\")\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"init\", \"extra\")\n    assert (code, out) == (2, \"\")\n    assert table_counts() == [1, 0, 0]\n\n\ndef test_count_reports_each_table_in_order(store):\n    make_account(\"CNTA\")\n    make_account(\"CNTB\")\n    assert cli_runner(\"count\")[1] == \"table,rows\\naccounts,2\\ncategories,0\\ntransactions,0\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_count_with_an_extra_argument_is_usage_error(store):\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"count\", \"extra\")\n    assert code == 2\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(err.strip().splitlines()) == 1\n\n\n# account add, get, rename, delete\n\ndef test_account_add_prints_the_zero_balance_row(store):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ADDOK1\", \"Added Account\")\n    assert code == 0\n    assert parse(out) == [ACCOUNT_HEADER, [\"ADDOK1\", \"Added Account\", \"0\", \"0.00\"]]\n    assert parse(cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", \"ADDOK1\")[1]) == parse(out)\n\n\ndef test_account_add_accepts_a_twelve_character_code_and_forty_character_name(store):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"A\" * 12, \"N\" * 40)\n    assert code == 0\n    assert parse(out)[1][:2] == [\"A\" * 12, \"N\" * 40]\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"bad\", [\"ADDBADCODE123X\", \"addlower\", \"ADD-DASH\", \"ADD SPACE\", \"\"])\ndef test_account_add_rejects_an_invalid_code_and_stores_nothing(store, bad):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", bad, \"Some Name\")\n    assert (code, out) == (3, \"\")\n    assert cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", bad)[0] == 4\n    assert table_counts()[0] == 0\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"bad\", [\"\", \"N\" * 41, \"has,comma\", \"has\\nnewline\"])\ndef test_account_add_rejects_an_invalid_name_and_stores_nothing(store, bad):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ADDBN\", bad)\n    assert (code, {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgPHb1ta9J7ZhdEdg4UQN","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The block is implemented. All 98 acceptance criteria for this block pass, and the full project suite is green with 251 tests, 141 of them new.\n\nRESULT: SUCCESS\n\nFILES CHANGED:\n- cli/views.py\n- cli/commands/init.py\n- cli/commands/count.py\n- cli/commands/account.py\n- cli/commands/load.py\n- cli/commands/txn.py\n- cli/commands/transfer.py\n- cli/commands/report.py\n- cli/commands/__init__.py (docstring only; it said the package was intentionally empty)\n- tests/test_commands.py\n\nSUMMARY:\n- **Commands:** all 21 stories are implemented as `ledger` subcommands. Each module registers its handlers on import, and the shared helpers (id parsing, row shapes, the `Txn` record) live in `cli/views.py`.\n- **Checks:** every validation, reference check, duplicate check, and balance-guard check runs before the first write. Rejections exit 3, not-found exits 4, usage errors exit 2, and operational failures exit 1.\n- **Data:** no commands hardcode a count, balance, or total. Amounts are integer cents throughout and are formatted by the shipped core helpers.\n- **Acceptance criteria:** I ran all 98 criteria from the 21 FEATURE files this block implements, each in its own rolled-back transaction to emulate the Drydock harness. All 98 pass. Drydock's real harness may behave differently, but the application store was left empty afterwards.\n- **Tests:** `tests/test_commands.py` covers every story, the error paths, boundaries, and the seed files. Each test runs against its own temporary SQLite store, so nothing touches `data/app.db`.\n- **Project suite:** `pytest -q` gives 251 passed, and `bin/test.sh` exits 0.\n- **End-to-end:** a smoke run through the `./ledger` launcher loaded the seed files and produced the expected exit codes. The grader `sources/run.sh` was not run: no criterion in this block invokes it.\n\nBLOCKERS:\n- None.\n\n<blueprint-decisions>\n[{\"spec\":\"FEATURE-LoadTransactions.md\",\"severity\":\"Material\",\"subject\":\"All-or-nothing writes\",\"decision\":\"The spec asks for one transaction, but the persistence package exposes no multi-statement transaction to application code, and the rules forbid driver calls. I validate every row and the balance guard before the first write, so validation failures store nothing. A database error partway through the write phase can still leave earlier rows stored. Is that acceptable, or should the persistence layer add a transaction facility?\"},{\"spec\":\"FEATURE-LoadAccounts.md\",\"severity\":\"Material\",\"subject\":\"All-or-nothing writes\",\"decision\":\"Same limitation as load transactions: validation completes before the first write, but a mid-write database failure can leave partial rows, because there is no transaction facility to wrap the writes. Is that acceptable?\"},{\"spec\":\"FEATURE-LoadCategories.md\",\"severity\":\"Material\",\"subject\":\"All-or-nothing writes\",\"decision\":\"Same limitation as the other loads. Categories also have no per-row delete declared, so no compensating undo is possible. Is that acceptable?\"},{\"spec\":\"FEATURE-Transfer.md\",\"severity\":\"Material\",\"subject\":\"Two-row atomicity\",\"decision\":\"Both TRANSFER rows are checked before the first write, but the two creates are not wrapped in a transaction. A failure on the second create would leave the first stored. Is that acceptable, or should the persistence layer add a transaction facility?\"},{\"spec\":\"FEATURE-Init.md\",\"severity\":\"Material\",\"subject\":\"Init empties tables rather than dropping them\",\"decision\":\"The story says drop and recreate, but the FEATURE Behavior says make sure the tables exist, then empty them in foreign-key order. I followed the Behavior. Tables are created from schema.sql only when a probe finds one missing, because execute_script is forbidden inside the acceptance transaction. Should init drop and recreate instead?\"},{\"spec\":\"FEATURE-LoadTransactions.md\",\"severity\":\"Low\",\"subject\":\"File txn_id range\",\"decision\":\"The spec says a non-integer txn_id is rejected but does not give a range. I accept only positive integers up to 2147483647, the INTEGER column limit, and reject 0 and negatives. Is that acceptable?\"},{\"spec\":\"FEATURE-Transfer.md\",\"severity\":\"Low\",\"subject\":\"Missing TRANSFER category\",\"decision\":\"If the store has no TRANSFER category, transfer exits 1 as an operational failure rather than 3, since it is a store configuration problem rather than bad input. Is that acceptable?\"}]\n</blueprint-decisions>"}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1161,"cache_read_input_tokens":191962,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1161},"output_tokens":6,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"3078c6c5-245a-4f57-9bc2-b3265db7f953","uuid":"3c2493d8-31e7-4b63-b689-d8b785b4f250","timestamp":"2026-10-25T16:40:40.064Z","request_id":"req_011CgPHb1XjWnEsjJicPGrWZ"}
